name: Vision2Words
description: Image captioning on Flickr8k with an EfficientNet-B0 encoder and LSTM, Transformer and retrieval-augmented Transformer decoders, plus retrieval + local LLM captioning. Includes a C++ inference binary on ONNX Runtime, a Nextflow pipeline, Docker images, and a Gradio demo.

paragraphs: Image captioning on Flickr8k, comparing an LSTM decoder with Bahdanau attention, a Transformer decoder, and a retrieval-augmented Transformer that also reads the captions of similar training images, all on the same frozen EfficientNet-B0 features. A second retrieval-based captioner hands the retrieved captions to a small local language model instead. Behind them are a from-scratch training pipeline and a C++/ONNX Runtime inference path.
Left: captions from all four decoders on test-split images the models never saw during training. Right: what the attention decoder is looking at for each word it writes.
